To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) there is a large variety of visualization tools, techniques and applications, but they are not well documented; 2) the visualization techniques used are mostly based on static analysis; 3) there is no tool that implements all techniques and 4) there is no standard to compare tools.

software visualization techniques and their tools can be classified in three main categories (3D Visualization, Static Analysis and Dynamic Analysis) and that the majority of these techniques and tools are implemented.
software visualization techniques are used to facilitate the comprehension of software, and that they are implemented as tools to help software developers and maintainers.

the state-of-the-art of software visualization techniques and their tools.

software visualization techniques and software visualization tools are a good alternative for the software comprehension process.

the visualization of source code and software architecture are the most used techniques, but they do not provide a complete comprehension of the system.
